system.description: The Sidereal makes eye contact with a target for long enough to exchange a few words, however brief, and activates this Charm. When the Sidereal does so, he gets a quick impression of what the target is thinking about at that moment. The target loses his train of thought in that moment as his mind goes blank for the blink of an eye. It is impossible to maintain eye contact for long enough to use this Charm if either the target or the Sidereal engages in physical combat. The Sidereal can swipe a target's surface thoughts while either or both of them engage in social combat.
